highlights:
Hot 100, Leon Thomas’ “Mutt” moves up. Will Alex Warren’s “Ordinary” or HUNTR/X’s “Golden” be able to make No. 1 this week? Tetris Kelly: Michael Jackson makes a holiday return to the charts as Taylor Swift still battles with KPop Demon Hunters for the No. 1 spot. This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Nov. 15. After a Halloween surge, “Thriller” hits the top 10. Morgan stays at No. 9. “Mutt” moves up to No. 8. “Folded” is locked in at No. 7, as is JB’s “Daisies” at No. 6. “Man I Need” at No. 5, and “Opalite” at No. 4. Alex remains steady at No. 3, same with “Golden” at No. 2. Nabbing a 5th week at No. 1 is Taylor Swift with “The Fate of Ophelia.” If you want more Billboard, make sure you hit the subscribe button and ring the bell to be notified on all our latest ... ### The Daily
